What a time to be alive. Did someone say “exocapitalism”?

> AI ... is not like that. AI absolutely incinerates capital. There’s huge capex for chips, data centres, and power generation; high COGS because of inference compute; fast-depreciating R&D in the form of training runs; generally lower gross margins; expensive data and talent; and no apparent upper limit to any of these, because of the bitter lesson.

[The Efficient Venture Markets Hypothesis ↗](https://pivotal.substack.com/p/the-efficient-venture-markets-hypothesis?r=233ko)
